recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central figure in stylized streetwear leaning against a red sports car, set against a dark background with cyan neon typographic overlays.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan neon glow reflecting on the subject's skin and clothing
Subject centered vertically between the top-aligned title and the car base
Contrast between the warm red of the vehicle and the cool cyan of the lighting and text
Aggressive, low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's presence
coreInvariants: High-gloss metallic surfaces on the car and jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally framed from the waist up, occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and sunglasses serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the bright red car hood below.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the neon title at the top, move down to the subject's face, follow the jewelry to the car, and return to the text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space at the top and sides to emphasize the central glow.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark teal for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant cyan for neon outlines and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saturated red for the sports car and warm skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing text and the dark background; high saturation in the red and cyan elements.

letterConstructionRules: Double-line neon tube effect with inner and outer glows
characterSpecificRedesigns: Incorporation of a 'rewind' icon (double triangle) inside a circular glyph
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A smaller, solid-fill sans-serif for secondary metadata placed above the main title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric, tech-inspired skeleton.
Provides the square-off geometric feel common in urban/tech aesthetics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic portrait of a man in a patterned leather jacket and sunglasses leaning on a red sports car at night. Use cyan rim lighting and a dark, hazy background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a two-line centered title in an expanded geometric sans-serif. Use a double-outline cyan neon effect with a soft outer glow. Integrate a rewind icon into one of the circular letters.

verificationChecks: Is the neon glow reflected on the subject?
Is the text centered and top-aligned?
Is the car color a saturated red?
Does the typography use a double-outline effect?

adjustableVariables: Specific model of the red car
Placement of the rewind icon within the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title wording

mustAchieve: Consistent cyan lighting across all elements
Sharp focus on the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Text is legible despite the neon effect
Lighting on the car matches the cyan ambient light
Subject's skin tones remain natural under the colored light
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle urban portrait with a high-contrast red/cyan color split and top-heavy neon geometric typography.
